homepageSummary.text: 当西方丈夫在泰国老去，养老金与经济优势如何同身体依赖并存？本期沿着跨国婚姻中的爱、金钱和照护，讨论女性能动性、晚年协商与关系后期的研究缺口。
homepageSummary.text_en: As Western husbands age in Thailand, how do pensions and economic advantages coexist with bodily dependency? This report examines love, money, care, women’s agency, and negotiation in later life, while identifying gaps in research on long-term relationships.
